strings.groups.1.sections.6.paras.1: 如果您在车站内或上车时需要协助，请在列车发车前至少一小时到达车站，并在到达时告知沙特铁路公司的工作人员。
strings.groups.1.sections.6.src.2.label: 沙特铁路公司：特殊协助

notes: 登车 -> 上车: approved page uses 上车 (groups.1.sections.1.paras.0 上车后请确认……); 登车 reads more like boarding a plane/ship.

请至少在发车前一小时到达 -> 请在列车发车前至少一小时到达车站: 至少 placed before the quantity it limits (natural order 发车前至少 N 小时); 列车 makes the train explicit since p0 ends on Uber; 到达车站 states where, as the operator's fact says 'the departure station'.
抵达时 -> 到达时: avoids the mixed 到达/抵达 pair inside one sentence; 'on arrival' kept, no 立即 or other addition.
Facts unchanged: at least / one hour / before departure / tell a staff member on arrival all present.
